feeds.title: Julie Dawn Fox Blog
feeds.description: Hi I am Julie Dawn Fox! Over the past 14 years, I've spent time exploring every region in Portugal, although I am forever adding to my wish list and revisiting old favorites. Much as I enjoy Portuguese cities, I get a real kick from searching out the hidden treasures and try to avoid touristy places and experiences. Portugal travel blog full of insider tips for planning a trip to Portugal. Itinerary planning services and insights into living in Portugal for expats.

feeds.title: Portugal.com
feeds.description: Portugal.com is an independently owned and operated tourism portal about Portugal. Portugal.com brings you to Portugal. Read our city guides, food & drink recommendations, learn about Portugese history and more.

feeds.title: Dan Flying Solo Blog » Portugal
feeds.description: Find Travel tips, photography, advice and things to do in Portugal to help you plan your visit. Hey, I'm Dan, and I'm obsessed with getting lost in new places and meeting new faces.

feeds.title: We Travel Portugal!
feeds.description: We're Annie and Ollie and we've been living in and traveling around Portugal for the last three years. We're two ex-pats discovering Portugal one day at a time, and we'd like to share our discoveries with you! Whether you are looking for day trips, complete destination guides, or recipes, you will find it in this blog.

feeds.title: Portugal Online Blog
feeds.description: Portugal Travel Stories is a compilation of articles about the beauty of a country, its wonderful people, timeless customs, rich history, & more. Portugal Online is the premier site for information and booking for those wanting to travel to Portugal.

feeds.title: Portugal Trails Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest updates and travel inspiration for Portugal. Portugal Trails provides a comprehensive set of services that allow you to discover our country in an independent, safe and comfortable way.

feeds.title: Portugalist
feeds.description: Welcome to Portugalist, a blog about Portugal and all things Portuguese. From where to stay in the Algarve to where to find the best pastéis de nata in Lisbon, we cover everything you need to know about Portugal. Portugalist is the web's leading guide to Portugal and all things Portuguese. The site was started by James Cave in 2016 after he became frustrated with the lack of good quality information about Portugal that he could find online - everything was either top-level or worse out-of-date or inaccurate.

feeds.title: Go To Portugal
feeds.description: By reading this blog, you will discover the sights, but above all, I will help you visit the authentic Portugal. Hello it's Tiago, since 2013, I discover and make you discover my paradise, Portugal!
